text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Spring Stakes, Rice 
Shower clearly identified her areas for 
improvement, burning with determination to 
try even harder.

Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon once again 
thrills the audience by showing off a turn 
of speed worthy of her title as the 
"Chestnut Bullet Train."

In order to catch up to Mihono Bourbon, 
she couldn't afford to stand still.

Rice Shower set her next goal on the 
Japanese Derby and began making 
preparations.
